title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — permitted payout
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute immediate refund — The permitted requested amount is the smallest of the negative receivable magnitude floored at zero, original payment principal minus prior disposal floored at zero, and the immediate payout ceiling; retain any surplus on account without further action.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for immediate refund — permitted payout?**

The permitted requested amount is the smallest of the negative receivable magnitude floored at zero, original payment principal minus prior disposal floored at zero, and the immediate payout ceiling; retain any surplus on account without further action.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the account surplus is 90 USD, the original principal is 120 USD with 50 USD already returned or refunded, and the payout ceiling is 60 USD. The remaining principal is 70 USD and the permitted requested amount is 60 USD.
